# OrganizeIt

> Connects to your phone's photo library and automatically sorts photos and videos into specific categories, separates business expense screenshots, sorts product photos by item type, shows storage per category and never uses an Other folder. Available on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.organizeit.app); the iPhone app is coming to the App Store. The first 100 photos are sorted free with no card. After that it is $1.99 for the first month, then $4.99 a month. There are no ads.
